orders.title: MAJOR ORDER
orders.briefing: Hold the designated planet and eliminate the mandated number of bile-producing Terminids in order to prove the safety of our chemical airstrikes, and to aid vital and fully planned research into airborne toxicity.

orders.title: STRATEGIC THREAT
orders.briefing: Protect and hold the designated planets in order to destroy the propaganda arrays being established by the Incineration Corps and Jet Brigade, and protect citizens from the Automatons' craven lies.
